title: Create a bedroom clean-air sanctuary
doThis: Pick the main bedroom to be your clean-air room. Keep the door closed, run a purifier before bedtime, and place it away from bedding.
whyItWorks: Keeping one room closed concentrates filtration so you breathe cleaner air while sleeping.
careful: Ensure the air path is not blocked by curtains or thick blankets.
why: Keeping one room closed concentrates filtration so you breathe cleaner air while sleeping.
effect_text: Keeping one room closed concentrates filtration so you breathe cleaner air while sleeping.
safety_note: Ensure the air path is not blocked by curtains or thick blankets.

title: Block door gaps with towels
doThis: Roll a damp or dry towel and place it firmly against the bottom crack of your bedroom door. This stops dirty air from leaking in from other rooms.
whyItWorks: Under-door gaps let unfiltered air enter easily. A simple physical block slows this indoor transfer.
careful: Ensure the towel does not create a tripping hazard in the dark.
why: Under-door gaps let unfiltered air enter easily. A simple physical block slows this indoor transfer.
effect_text: Under-door gaps let unfiltered air enter easily. A simple physical block slows this indoor transfer.
safety_note: Ensure the towel does not create a tripping hazard in the dark.

title: Stop incense, dhoop and coils
doThis: Keep incense sticks, dhoop, and burning mosquito coils out of the bedroom and home. Use mosquito nets or non-burning repellent alternatives instead.
whyItWorks: Burning incense and coils releases heavy loads of fine particles and chemical irritants directly into stagnant indoor air.
careful: Electric mosquito liquid vaporizers can still emit chemical fumes, so maintain gentle room air movement.
why: Burning incense and coils releases heavy loads of fine particles and chemical irritants directly into stagnant indoor air.
effect_text: Burning incense and coils releases heavy loads of fine particles and chemical irritants directly into stagnant indoor air.
safety_note: Electric mosquito liquid vaporizers can still emit chemical fumes, so maintain gentle room air movement.

title: Run kitchen chimney or exhaust
doThis: Turn on your kitchen exhaust fan or chimney right before lighting the stove. Keep it running while cooking and for several minutes after you finish.
whyItWorks: Mechanical exhaust draws oil droplets, combustion gases, and soot directly out of the house before they spread.
careful: Clean grease filters regularly so the exhaust fan moves air freely without fire risk.
why: Mechanical exhaust draws oil droplets, combustion gases, and soot directly out of the house before they spread.
effect_text: Mechanical exhaust draws oil droplets, combustion gases, and soot directly out of the house before they spread.
safety_note: Clean grease filters regularly so the exhaust fan moves air freely without fire risk.

title: Use lids and pressure cookers
doThis: Cook with tight-fitting lids on pots and use a pressure cooker whenever possible. This traps steam and cuts cooking time substantially.
whyItWorks: Shortening stove burning time reduces total combustion emissions and airborne oil vapors released into the kitchen.
careful: Release cooker pressure away from your face and under an active exhaust fan.
why: Shortening stove burning time reduces total combustion emissions and airborne oil vapors released into the kitchen.
effect_text: Shortening stove burning time reduces total combustion emissions and airborne oil vapors released into the kitchen.
safety_note: Release cooker pressure away from your face and under an active exhaust fan.

title: Lower heat during stovetop frying
doThis: Avoid overheating cooking oil to its smoking point and reduce flame height during tadka or deep frying. Cover the pan between stirs.
whyItWorks: Overheated cooking oils break down chemically into dense ultrafine aerosol particles and acrolein vapors.
careful: Hot oil can splatter, so lower items gently into the pan.
why: Overheated cooking oils break down chemically into dense ultrafine aerosol particles and acrolein vapors.
effect_text: Overheated cooking oils break down chemically into dense ultrafine aerosol particles and acrolein vapors.
safety_note: Hot oil can splatter, so lower items gently into the pan.

title: Switch to an induction cooktop
doThis: Prepare meals using an electric induction plate instead of an open flame gas or biomass stove. It generates heat without flame emissions.
whyItWorks: Electric induction transfers heat magnetically without producing nitrogen dioxide, carbon monoxide, or soot.
careful: Requires induction-compatible cookware with flat magnetic bases.
why: Electric induction transfers heat magnetically without producing nitrogen dioxide, carbon monoxide, or soot.
effect_text: Electric induction transfers heat magnetically without producing nitrogen dioxide, carbon monoxide, or soot.
safety_note: Requires induction-compatible cookware with flat magnetic bases.

title: Air out biomass cooking outdoors
doThis: If using firewood, cow dung, or coal, cook in an open veranda rather than inside closed rooms.
whyItWorks: Cooking with firewood without open air creates dangerous smoke and soot inside.
careful: Keep young children and elderly family members away from the downwind smoke path.
why: Cooking with firewood without open air creates dangerous smoke and soot inside.
effect_text: Keeps toxic smoke from trapping inside your home.
safety_note: Keep young children and elderly family members away from the downwind smoke path.

title: Damp-mop floors instead of sweeping
doThis: Clean floors with a damp mop and wipe tabletops with a damp cloth instead of dry broom sweeping. Rinse the mop frequently in clean water.
whyItWorks: Dry brooms launch settled dust and fine tiny dust and smoke particles back into the air you breathe. Moisture binds the dust securely.
careful: Do not leave floors overly wet to prevent slip risks and mold growth.
why: Dry brooms launch settled dust and fine tiny dust and smoke particles back into the air you breathe. Moisture binds the dust securely.
effect_text: Dry brooms launch settled dust and fine tiny dust and smoke particles back into the air you breathe. Moisture binds the dust securely.
safety_note: Do not leave floors overly wet to prevent slip risks and mold growth.

title: Choose HEPA over ionizing purifiers
doThis: When selecting a purifier, pick mechanical HEPA filtration and avoid devices with ozone generators or ionizers. Check that the clean air delivery rate suits your room size.
whyItWorks: HEPA traps dust and smoke physically on fibrous mesh. Ionizers and ozone generators create harmful lung irritants and secondary pollutants.
careful: Ensure the unit is sized appropriately for the specific room dimensions.
why: HEPA traps dust and smoke physically on fibrous mesh. Ionizers and ozone generators create harmful lung irritants and secondary pollutants.
effect_text: HEPA traps dust and smoke physically on fibrous mesh. Ionizers and ozone generators create harmful lung irritants and secondary pollutants.
safety_note: Ensure the unit is sized appropriately for the specific room dimensions.

title: Avoid aerosol sprays and fresheners
doThis: Skip plug-in room fresheners, scented candles, and aerosol spray cleaners. Use plain fragrance-free soap, water, or baking soda for freshness.
whyItWorks: Commercial air fresheners emit volatile organic compounds that react in indoor air to form secondary fine dust and smoke.
careful: Always keep household cleaning solutions labeled and out of reach of young children.
why: Commercial air fresheners emit volatile organic compounds that react in indoor air to form secondary fine dust and smoke.
effect_text: Commercial air fresheners emit volatile organic compounds that react in indoor air to form secondary fine dust and smoke.
safety_note: Always keep household cleaning solutions labeled and out of reach of young children.

title: Replace purifier filters on schedule
doThis: Vacuum the outer pre-filter regularly and replace the main HEPA cartridge when indicated. Keep spare filters stored in sealed plastic.
whyItWorks: Clogged filters reduce airflow dramatically and strain the blower motor, diminishing clean air delivery across the room.
careful: Do not wash standard paper HEPA filters with water, as moisture ruins the microglass fiber structure.
why: Clogged filters reduce airflow dramatically and strain the blower motor, diminishing clean air delivery across the room.
effect_text: Clogged filters reduce airflow dramatically and strain the blower motor, diminishing clean air delivery across the room.
safety_note: Do not wash standard paper HEPA filters with water, as moisture ruins the microglass fiber structure.

title: Shut windows during peak smog
doThis: Keep all exterior windows and balcony doors firmly closed during morning and evening smog peaks. Let fresh air wait until cleaner daylight hours.
whyItWorks: with windows and doors shut, indoor PM2.5 is still about 55-60% of outdoor levels in smoke events
careful: Do not keep the home fully sealed if cooking with unvented gas or solid fuels without an active exhaust.
why: with windows and doors shut, indoor PM2.5 is still about 55-60% of outdoor levels in smoke events
effect_text: with windows and doors shut, indoor PM2.5 is still about 55-60% of outdoor levels in smoke events
safety_note: Do not keep the home fully sealed if cooking with unvented gas or solid fuels without an active exhaust.

title: Air out during cleanest hour
doThis: Open opposite windows briefly during the forecast's cleanest afternoon window to flush out carbon dioxide. Close them promptly once the hour ends.
whyItWorks: Short bursts of airing out exchange stale indoor carbon dioxide when outdoor smoke levels hit their daily minimum.
careful: Skip outdoor airing completely if outdoor air quality remains in the severe band all day.
why: Short bursts of airing out exchange stale indoor carbon dioxide when outdoor smoke levels hit their daily minimum.
effect_text: Short bursts of airing out exchange stale indoor carbon dioxide when outdoor smoke levels hit their daily minimum.
safety_note: Skip outdoor airing completely if outdoor air quality remains in the severe band all day.

title: Seal drafty gaps with weatherstripping
doThis: Apply self-adhesive foam or rubber weatherstrip tape along loose window frames and exterior door edges. Press firmly along joints to stop drafts.
whyItWorks: Physical seals block the natural air outside air leaking in pathways that carry exterior fine soot and road dust into your living spaces.
careful: Ensure windows can still unlatch smoothly for emergency egress.
why: Physical seals block the natural air outside air leaking in pathways that carry exterior fine soot and road dust into your living spaces.
effect_text: Physical seals block the natural air outside air leaking in pathways that carry exterior fine soot and road dust into your living spaces.
safety_note: Ensure windows can still unlatch smoothly for emergency egress.

title: Run recirculating fan or AC
doThis: Operate your split air conditioner or ceiling fan with windows shut, keeping indoor air moving gently. If using a window AC, ensure the fresh-air damper is switched completely shut.
whyItWorks: Split air conditioners recirculate indoor air without drawing in polluted outdoor air. Closing fresh-air vents prevents outside soot entry.
careful: Standard room AC dust filters trap large fibers and lint, but do not capture fine PM2.5 particles on their own.
why: Split air conditioners recirculate indoor air without drawing in polluted outdoor air. Closing fresh-air vents prevents outside soot entry.
effect_text: Split air conditioners recirculate indoor air without drawing in polluted outdoor air. Closing fresh-air vents prevents outside soot entry.
safety_note: Standard room AC dust filters trap large fibers and lint, but do not capture fine PM2.5 particles on their own.

title: Run portable True HEPA purifier
doThis: Place a portable True HEPA air purifier in the room where your family spends the most time. Keep it running continuously on medium or high speed with windows closed.
whyItWorks: a portable HEPA purifier may cut indoor PM2.5 by about 50-80% when run continuously with doors and windows closed
careful: Position the unit away from walls and drapery to maintain clear inlet and outlet airflow.
why: a portable HEPA purifier may cut indoor PM2.5 by about 50-80% when run continuously with doors and windows closed
effect_text: a portable HEPA purifier may cut indoor PM2.5 by about 50-80% when run continuously with doors and windows closed
safety_note: Position the unit away from walls and drapery to maintain clear inlet and outlet airflow.

title: Build DIY box-fan filter
doThis: Fasten a MERV-13 furnace filter securely to the intake side of a standard box fan with duct tape. Run it in a closed room with airflow unobstructed.
whyItWorks: a DIY box-fan filter with MERV-13 filters by about 40-70% in studies
careful: Use an approved box fan with an enclosed motor and do not leave it unattended while away from home.
why: a DIY box-fan filter with MERV-13 filters by about 40-70% in studies
effect_text: a DIY box-fan filter with MERV-13 filters by about 40-70% in studies
safety_note: Use an approved box fan with an enclosed motor and do not leave it unattended while away from home.

title: Wear fitted N95 respirator outdoors
doThis: Wear a certified N95 or FFP2 respirator when outside during high pollution episodes. Press the metal nose clip snugly against the bridge of your nose for a seal.
whyItWorks: Certified electrostatic filter media captures microscopic airborne tiny dust and smoke particles that cloth bandanas and surgical masks miss.
careful: Respirators are not recommended for infants and children under age two. Anyone with respiratory distress should rest indoors.
why: Certified electrostatic filter media captures microscopic airborne tiny dust and smoke particles that cloth bandanas and surgical masks miss.
effect_text: Certified electrostatic filter media captures microscopic airborne tiny dust and smoke particles that cloth bandanas and surgical masks miss.
safety_note: Respirators are not recommended for infants and children under age two. Anyone with respiratory distress should rest indoors.

title: Move strenuous exercise indoors
doThis: Replace outdoor runs and sports with indoor yoga or gentle stretching. Avoid heavy breathing in smoggy air.
whyItWorks: Hard exercise makes you breathe much more air and pulls smoke deep into your lungs.
careful: Exercise in a closed room with air cleaning running whenever possible.
why: Hard exercise makes you breathe much more air and pulls smoke deep into your lungs.
effect_text: Protects your lungs by keeping heavy breathing inside clean indoor air.
safety_note: Exercise in a closed room with air cleaning running whenever possible.

title: Shift outdoor trips off-peak
doThis: Schedule errands during midday when smoke spreads out. Avoid walking along busy roads during rush hour.
whyItWorks: Cold air traps smoke near the ground during mornings, whereas midday sun spreads out soot.
careful: Check hourly forecasts to confirm the cleanest midday window before heading outside.
why: Cold air traps smoke near the ground during mornings, whereas midday sun spreads out soot.
effect_text: Reduces smoke breathed by choosing cleaner midday hours.
safety_note: Check hourly forecasts to confirm the cleanest midday window before heading outside.

title: Choose cleaner low-traffic travel routes
doThis: Pick neighborhood interior streets and paths buffered by trees rather than congested arterial corridors. Keep distance from idling buses and trucks.
whyItWorks: Vehicle exhaust emissions drop rapidly with even short distances away from congested traffic lanes.
careful: Always prioritize personal safety and well-lit walkways when navigating alternative routes.
why: Vehicle exhaust emissions drop rapidly with even short distances away from congested traffic lanes.
effect_text: Vehicle exhaust emissions drop rapidly with even short distances away from congested traffic lanes.
safety_note: Always prioritize personal safety and well-lit walkways when navigating alternative routes.

title: Never burn waste or leaves
doThis: Compost dried leaves and garden trimmings instead of setting them on fire. Hand municipal waste and plastics directly to designated sanitation collectors.
whyItWorks: Low-temperature smoldering of leaves and plastic releases concentrated toxic dioxins, furans, and black carbon at ground level.
careful: Ensure hot ash or embers are completely extinguished to prevent accidental fire spreading.
why: Low-temperature smoldering of leaves and plastic releases concentrated toxic dioxins, furans, and black carbon at ground level.
effect_text: Low-temperature smoldering of leaves and plastic releases concentrated toxic dioxins, furans, and black carbon at ground level.
safety_note: Ensure hot ash or embers are completely extinguished to prevent accidental fire spreading.

title: Report open burning via SAMEER
doThis: Take a photo of municipal leaf or plastic burning and lodge a complaint on the CPCB SAMEER app. Alert local ward authorities.
whyItWorks: Official complaint tracking prompts regulatory enforcement action from local pollution control boards and municipal wards.
careful: Maintain a safe distance from burning sites and confrontational situations while documenting.
why: Official complaint tracking prompts regulatory enforcement action from local pollution control boards and municipal wards.
effect_text: Official complaint tracking prompts regulatory enforcement action from local pollution control boards and municipal wards.
safety_note: Maintain a safe distance from burning sites and confrontational situations while documenting.

title: Advocate for cleaner shared spaces
doThis: Encourage your school board or office administration to inspect HVAC filters and keep doors closed during smog peaks. Share simple clean-air guidance.
whyItWorks: Institutional awareness leads to coordinated building filtration upgrades that safeguard vulnerable children and staff.
careful: Focus recommendations on practical certified interventions like MERV filtration rather than unproven gadgets.
why: Institutional awareness leads to coordinated building filtration upgrades that safeguard vulnerable children and staff.
effect_text: Institutional awareness leads to coordinated building filtration upgrades that safeguard vulnerable children and staff.
safety_note: Focus recommendations on practical certified interventions like MERV filtration rather than unproven gadgets.

title: Practice cleaner daily commuting habits
doThis: Keep vehicle windows up with AC set to cabin air recirculation mode. Prefer closed metro trains over open auto-rickshaws, and wear an N95 when on two-wheelers.
whyItWorks: Cabin air recirculation prevents direct tailpipe exhaust outside air leaking in. Metro transit separates commuters from ground-level road exhaust plumes.
careful: This is general guidance, not live route data.
why: Cabin air recirculation prevents direct tailpipe exhaust outside air leaking in. Metro transit separates commuters from ground-level road exhaust plumes.
effect_text: Cabin air recirculation prevents direct tailpipe exhaust outside air leaking in. Metro transit separates commuters from ground-level road exhaust plumes.

title: Myth: Houseplants clean room air
doThis: Enjoy houseplants for their natural beauty, but rely on mechanical HEPA filters for indoor smoke and dust removal.
whyItWorks: NASA sealed-chamber experiments did not reflect actual homes, where fresh air exchanges air vastly faster than potted plants can absorb pollutants.
careful: Overwatering indoor potted plants creates damp soil that promotes mold spore growth.
why: NASA sealed-chamber experiments did not reflect actual homes, where fresh air exchanges air vastly faster than potted plants can absorb pollutants.
effect_text: NASA sealed-chamber experiments did not reflect actual homes, where fresh air exchanges air vastly faster than potted plants can absorb pollutants.

title: Myth: Cloth masks block PM2.5
doThis: Use certified N95 or FFP2 respirators rather than cloth bandanas, handkerchiefs, or loose surgical masks for smog.
whyItWorks: Cloth weave gaps are hundreds of times larger than fine tiny dust and smoke particles, letting microscopic soot pass straight through.
careful: A mask must form a tight perimeter seal against your face to provide protection.
why: Cloth weave gaps are hundreds of times larger than fine tiny dust and smoke particles, letting microscopic soot pass straight through.
effect_text: Cloth weave gaps are hundreds of times larger than fine tiny dust and smoke particles, letting microscopic soot pass straight through.

title: Myth: Salt lamps clean air
doThis: Use salt lamps as gentle ambient nightlights, not as air cleaners. Rely on verified mechanical filters for smoke and dust removal.
whyItWorks: Salt crystals do not generate sufficient ionic charges or airflow to capture or neutralize airborne dust and smoke pollutants.
careful: Heated salt lamps can attract moisture in humid weather and drip onto electrical outlets.
why: Salt crystals do not generate sufficient ionic charges or airflow to capture or neutralize airborne dust and smoke pollutants.
effect_text: Salt crystals do not generate sufficient ionic charges or airflow to capture or neutralize airborne dust and smoke pollutants.
safety_note: Heated salt lamps can attract moisture in humid weather and drip onto electrical outlets.

title: Myth: Water bowls absorb pollution
doThis: Avoid placing open water bowls or cut onions in rooms hoping to capture smog. Keep doors and windows closed with proper filtration instead.
whyItWorks: Static water and cut onions do not have electrostatic properties or air currents to capture airborne microscopic soot.
careful: Standing water bowls in warm rooms create breeding spots for mosquitoes.
why: Static water and cut onions do not have electrostatic properties or air currents to capture airborne microscopic soot.
effect_text: Static water and cut onions do not have electrostatic properties or air currents to capture airborne microscopic soot.
safety_note: Standing water bowls in warm rooms create breeding spots for mosquitoes.

title: Myth: Wet cloths block smog
doThis: Close and latch windows firmly instead of hanging damp towels or curtains over open window frames.
whyItWorks: Damp cloths fail to create an airtight seal, while outdoor air pressure forces microscopic particles around the damp fabric.
careful: Damp textiles hung indoors increase room humidity and encourage mold growth.
why: Damp cloths fail to create an airtight seal, while outdoor air pressure forces microscopic particles around the damp fabric.
effect_text: Damp cloths fail to create an airtight seal, while outdoor air pressure forces microscopic particles around the damp fabric.
safety_note: Damp textiles hung indoors increase room humidity and encourage mold growth.

title: Myth: Detox drinks flush PM2.5
doThis: Drink clean water to stay hydrated, but do not rely on herbal teas or jaggery cleanses to remove lung soot.
whyItWorks: Inhaled fine particles enter the respiratory tract and bloodstream directly, while drinks pass entirely through the digestive tract.
careful: Excessive consumption of concentrated herbal concoctions can cause gastrointestinal irritation.
why: Inhaled fine particles enter the respiratory tract and bloodstream directly, while drinks pass entirely through the digestive tract.
effect_text: Inhaled fine particles enter the respiratory tract and bloodstream directly, while drinks pass entirely through the digestive tract.
safety_note: Excessive consumption of concentrated herbal concoctions can cause gastrointestinal irritation.

title: Pick lightest hour for outdoor tasks
doThis: Run essential errands during midday when smoke spreads out. Keep trips short and gentle.
whyItWorks: Ground smoke spreads out as midday sun warms the air, reducing breathed smoke.
careful: Check the hourly smog reading before heading out, and wear an N95 mask.
why: Ground smoke spreads out as midday sun warms the air, reducing breathed smoke.
effect_text: Cuts smoke intake by avoiding peak morning and night smoke hours.
safety_note: Check the hourly smog reading before heading out, and wear an N95 mask.

title: Good day for outside workout
doThis: Enjoy a walk, jogging, cycling, or outdoor sports in parks and grounds.
whyItWorks: Outdoor air is clean and safe. Your lungs breathe fresh air freely.
careful: Stay hydrated and enjoy clean natural air.
why: Outdoor air is clean and safe. Your lungs breathe fresh air freely.
